packages.summary: Hanoi's temples and Old Quarter, a day in Ninh Binh and an overnight cruise on Ha Long Bay, in one northern Vietnam holiday.
packages.overview: This northern Vietnam holiday starts in Hanoi, where you visit Ba Dinh Square, the Temple of Literature, Hoan Kiem Lake and the Old Quarter. A day trip takes you to Ninh Binh for the Dinh and Le temples at Hoa Lu and a boat ride through Tam Coc. The journey ends with an overnight cruise among the limestone islets of Ha Long Bay before a return to Hanoi and your flight home.

Walk through the Old Quarter, Hanoi's historic web of trading streets
Dinh and Le temples at Hoa Lu, Vietnam's ancient capital
Boat trip through the rice fields and limestone hills of Tam Coc
Overnight cruise on Ha Long Bay with grotto, kayaking and swimming stops
Cooking demonstration on board and sunrise over the bay

packages.summary: A beach holiday on Phu Quoc with VinWonders and Vinpearl Safari, a speedboat island-hopping day and the Hon Thom cable car.

Another day takes you to the Coconut Prison and by speedboat to the islands of Mong Tay, Gam Ghi and May Rut, with the Hon Thom cable car ride back. A day at leisure remains before your flight home.

group_trips.title: Vietnam Hanoi, Ha Long Bay and Hoi An Group Trip
group_trips.summary: Travel with a trip captain from Hanoi and an overnight Ha Long Bay cruise to Hoi An, Ba Na Hills and Da Nang.
group_trips.overview:
This group trip covers the best of northern and central Vietnam in eight days. You begin in Hanoi with its lakes, temples and Old Quarter, then spend a night aboard a cruise among the limestone islands of Ha Long Bay.

A flight takes the group south to Da Nang and the lantern-lit lanes of Hoi An. A day at Ba Na Hills brings the Golden Bridge and a ride on one of the world's longest cable cars, before the Marble Mountains and Da Nang's coast complete the trip.

A trip captain accompanies the group throughout, and Indian meal options can be arranged on request.
highlights: Hanoi's Temple of Literature, Ba Dinh Square and the Old Quarter
Overnight cruise among the limestone karsts of Ha Long Bay
Kayaking or swimming stops and a cave visit on the bay, weather permitting
Hoi An Ancient Town and its lantern-lit lanes
Golden Bridge and the French Village at Ba Na Hills
Marble Mountains and the Lady Buddha at Linh Ung Pagoda in Da Nang
Domestic flight from Hanoi to Da Nang included
Trip captain throughout and Indian meal options on request

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Old Quarter Evening Walk
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport, where your trip captain meets the group.
Transfer to your 4-star hotel in Hanoi and check in.
Take an easy evening walk around Hoan Kiem Lake and the Old Quarter.
Dinner at leisure; Indian meal options can be arranged on request.
Overnight stay in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Hanoi City Tour | Temple of Literature
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, visit Ba Dinh Square and see the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum from outside.
Stop at the One Pillar Pagoda and the Temple of Literature, Vietnam's first national university.
Spend the afternoon in the Old Quarter with its narrow streets, street food and craft shops.
An optional evening water puppet show can be arranged, subject to availability.
Overnight stay in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Ha Long Bay | Overnight Cruise
itinerary.description:
Drive from Hanoi to Ha Long Bay, with a comfort stop on the way.
Board your cruise, settle into your cabin and enjoy lunch on board.
Cruise past limestone islets with stops for kayaking or swimming and a cave visit, weather permitting.
Watch the sunset from the deck, then enjoy dinner on board.
Overnight stay on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay Sunrise | Return to Hanoi
itinerary.description:
Wake early to watch the sun rise over the bay.
Have breakfast or brunch on board while cruising among the islets, then disembark.
Drive back to Hanoi and check in at the hotel.
The rest of the day is at leisure for last-minute shopping or a rest.
Overnight stay in Hanoi.

itinerary.title: Fly to Da Nang | Hoi An Ancient Town
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, transfer to Noi Bai airport for the short flight to Da Nang.
Drive to Hoi An, about 45 minutes away, and check in.
Stroll through Hoi An Ancient Town, including the Japanese Covered Bridge, as the lanterns light up.
Dinner at leisure; Hoi An is known for its tailors and cafes.
Overnight stay in Hoi An.

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills | Golden Bridge
itinerary.description:
Drive from Hoi An to Ba Na Hills and ride the cable car up the mountain.
Walk across the Golden Bridge, held up by two giant stone hands, and explore the French Village and gardens.
Lunch at leisure in the hill resort, then return to Hoi An in the afternoon.
The evening is free for the old town or an optional lantern boat ride on the river.
Overnight stay in Hoi An.

itinerary.title: Hoi An Morning | Marble Mountains and Da Nang
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a relaxed morning in Hoi An, with an optional cooking class or cycle ride through the paddy fields.
Check out and drive to Da Nang to visit the Marble Mountains, hills with caves and pagodas.
Continue to Linh Ung Pagoda on the Son Tra Peninsula, home to the tall Lady Buddha statue and wide coastal views.
Spend the evening free along the Han River or at My Khe beach.
Overnight stay in Da Nang.

itinerary.title: Departure from Da Nang
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and enjoy free time until your transfer.
Transfer to Da Nang International Airport for your onward flight.
Depart Vietnam with a camera full of memories.

group_trips.title: Vietnam Saigon, Mekong Delta and Phu Quoc Island Group Trip
group_trips.summary: Ho Chi Minh City, the Cu Chi Tunnels and the Mekong Delta, followed by three beach days on Phu Quoc, with a trip captain throughout.
group_trips.overview:
This group trip pairs the energy of southern Vietnam with island relaxation. The first three days cover Ho Chi Minh City, the Cu Chi Tunnels and a day on the waterways of the Mekong Delta.

You then fly to Phu Quoc for three nights, with an island-hopping day by speedboat to Mong Tay, Gam Ghi and May Rut, a ride on the Hon Thom cable car, and a day of local sights and the night market.

A trip captain accompanies the group, and Indian meal options can be arranged on request.
highlights: Notre-Dame Cathedral, the Central Post Office and Ben Thanh Market in Ho Chi Minh City
Cu Chi Tunnels, the wartime tunnel network outside the city
Day trip into the Mekong Delta with a boat ride and fruit tasting
Domestic flight from Ho Chi Minh City to Phu Quoc included
Speedboat island hopping to Mong Tay, Gam Ghi and May Rut
Hon Thom cable car ride
Dinh Cau Night Market and local sights on Phu Quoc
Trip captain throughout and Indian meal options on request

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh City | Saigon Riverside
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Tan Son Nhat International Airport, where your trip captain meets the group.
Transfer to your 4-star hotel and check in.
Take an easy evening walk along Nguyen Hue walking street towards the Saigon River.
Dinner at leisure; Indian meal options can be arranged on request.
Overnight stay in Ho Chi Minh City.

itinerary.title: Cu Chi Tunnels | Colonial Saigon
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, drive to the Cu Chi Tunnels and explore the tunnel network used during the war.
Return to the city for lunch at leisure.
See the Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office, two landmarks of French colonial Saigon.
Browse the stalls of Ben Thanh Market before returning to the hotel.
Overnight stay in Ho Chi Minh City.

itinerary.title: Mekong Delta Day Trip
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, drive south to the Mekong Delta.
Take a boat ride along the river and a rowing boat through a narrow canal.
Taste tropical fruit and enjoy lunch at a local restaurant.
Return to Ho Chi Minh City in the late afternoon, with the evening free.
Overnight stay in Ho Chi Minh City.

itinerary.title: Fly to Phu Quoc | Beach Afternoon
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for the short flight to Phu Quoc.
Transfer to your resort and check in.
Spend the afternoon on the beach or by the pool.
Watch the sunset over the sea; dinner is at leisure.
Overnight stay in Phu Quoc.

itinerary.title: Island Hopping | Hon Thom Cable Car
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, drive to An Thoi Harbour in the south of the island.
Take a speedboat to Mong Tay, Gam Ghi and May Rut islands for swimming and snorkelling stops, with lunch included.
Ride the Hon Thom cable car back to An Thoi station, subject to sea and wind conditions.
Return to the resort for the evening.
Overnight stay in Phu Quoc.

itinerary.title: Phu Quoc Local Sights | Dinh Cau Night Market
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, visit the Coconut Prison, a former wartime prison.
See how Phu Quoc's famous fish sauce is made and visit a pepper farm.
Have a relaxed afternoon at leisure at the resort.
In the evening, browse Dinh Cau Night Market for seafood and souvenirs.
Overnight stay in Phu Quoc.

itinerary.title: Departure from Phu Quoc
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and enjoy free time until your transfer.
Transfer to Phu Quoc International Airport for your onward flight.
Depart Vietnam with sand still in your shoes.
